instructions: Speak in a warm, confident Nigerian English accent, like a polished Lagos business presenter. Natural Nigerian rhythm and intonation, clear and unhurried so every word is easy to follow. Friendly and energetic, never robotic. Say 'RUNVAX' as 'Run-vax'.

scenes.text: Good day! What if your business could have an A.I. agent that works for you all day, answering visitors, qualifying leads, and writing content for your website? In the next few minutes, I will show you how to build one with RUNVAX, in plain English, with no code.
I am inside RUNVAX two point zero. Here, under A.I. Agents, you see the six built in agents that run your campaigns. And here are your own agents. Let us build one. I click, build an agent.

All you do is describe the agent you want, in plain English. RUNVAX works out what to build. Let me show you something honest. If I ask for something RUNVAX cannot do yet, like a WhatsApp bot, it tells me clearly, and your request is noted. So now let me ask for something it can build. I run a payroll software company, and I want a chat assistant on my website that qualifies visitors and books demos.

I click, build my agent. Watch the progress. RUNVAX understands my business, writes what the assistant should know, and chooses the qualifying questions. Nothing is invented. It only uses what I told it.

Here is the agent, ready to review. My business name, what I do, who I sell to, the tone, and what the assistant knows. Below are the qualifying questions it will ask visitors, one at a time, like company size and what they use today. I can edit anything here, my booking link, my privacy link, and where it sends my new leads.

Now the best part. Before I save anything, I can try it. This is a safe preview. I chat as a visitor would. I ask how it works and what it costs. Notice it answers from my facts, and it never makes up a price. Now I give my details, and see what it picked up, the name and the email. In a real chat, this becomes a lead, and I get an email. Nothing here is saved or sent.
I am happy with it. I save the agent, and then I switch it on.

Now, deploy. For a website, I copy this one line, and paste it into my site. It works on WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, and plain HTML. Or I can share this hosted page. And for Telegram, I create a bot with BotFather, paste the token here, and press connect. The same assistant now answers on Telegram.

Here is a customer website with the agent installed. A visitor clicks the chat bubble. Notice it says plainly, A.I. assistant, and tells the visitor how their messages are used. The visitor asks a question, then shares their name and email.
Back in RUNVAX, under conversations, there it is. A new lead, with the name, the email, and the full conversation. And you also get an email, so you can follow up while the lead is warm.

The same way, you can build a visibility agent. I describe it, a content agent for my payroll business, and RUNVAX builds it. I open, try it, and write a preview article. Real, helpful content for my website, with a frequently asked questions section that search engines and A.I. assistants love. I approve it, or I let it publish on a schedule, to my website, to WordPress, or an R.S.S. feed.
That is it. Describe it, review it, try it, and deploy it. A.I. agents for your business, built in minutes with RUNVAX. Start free today, at runvax dot com.
